scripts.build:unified-web: pnpm --dir apps/mobile exec expo export --platform web --output-dir dist-web
scripts.test:cross-platform: pnpm --dir apps/mobile exec vitest run tests/cross-platform-parity.test.ts tests/family-mobile-core.test.ts
scripts.eval:family-model-live: pnpm --filter @family/ai-gateway build && pnpm --filter @family/family-model build && node tools/eval-family-model.mjs --live
scripts.run:family-model-live: pnpm --filter @family/ai-gateway build && pnpm --filter @family/family-model build && node tools/run-family-model-live.mjs
scripts.smoke:family-model-live: pnpm --filter @family/ai-gateway build && pnpm --filter @family/family-model build && node tools/run-family-model-live-smoke.mjs
scripts.test:unit: pnpm --filter @family/contracts test && pnpm --filter @family/web test && pnpm --filter @family/api exec vitest run --config vitest.unit.config.ts
scripts.test:integration: node tools/testdb.mjs run --filter @family/api exec vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e: node tools/testdb.mjs run --filter @family/api exec vitest run --config vitest.e2e.config.ts
scripts.test:required: pnpm run build && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run testdb:reset && pnpm run test:integration && pnpm run test:e2e
scripts.legacy:seed:clean-small: pnpm --filter @family/fels-contracts build && pnpm --filter @family/fels-api build && pnpm --filter @family/fels-api seed:clean-small
scripts.legacy:seed:dirty-core: pnpm --filter @family/fels-contracts build && pnpm --filter @family/fels-api build && pnpm --filter @family/fels-api seed:dirty-core
scripts.legacy:test: pnpm --filter @family/fels-contracts test && pnpm --filter @family/fels-api test && pnpm --filter @family/fels-web test
